dispatched.title: Currency formatter drops the fractional part for non-USD currencies
dispatched.description: format_amount() truncates instead of rounding for currencies with more than two minor-unit digits.
dispatched.suggestion: Use round() with the currency's minor-unit precision instead of an implicit floor.
